```{r}
library(eDNAfuns)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(stringdist)
```


## Starting point 

```{r}
lens <-read_delim(here("data/lengths.txt"), delim = " ", col_names = c("file", "lens")) |> 
  mutate(file = basename(file))

lens |> 
  group_by(file) |> tally(sort=T)
```

```{r}
lens |> 
   group_by(file) |> add_tally(sort=T) |> 
  filter (n>100) |> 
  mutate (file = str_remove(file, "Locus_")) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x= file, y = lens))+
  geom_boxplot()
```


```{r}
lens |> filter (file != "mitogenomes.fa") |> 
   group_by(file) |> add_tally(sort=T) |> 
  filter (n>100) |> 
  mutate (file = str_remove(file, "Locus_")) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x= file, y = lens))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,500))
```

For mitogenomes, get starting coverage per family

```{r}
seqs_to_remove <- ("PX120486")
fasta_reader(here("data/mitogenomes.fa")) |> 
  filter (!str_detect(header,seqs_to_remove )) |> 
  
  mutate(len = str_length(seq)) |> 
  select(header, len) |> 
  separate (header, into = c("seqID", "taxid", "taxonomy"), sep = "\\|") ->mitodata

mitodata |>  
  group_by(taxonomy ) |> 
  tally() -> starting_point
```

List good outputs

```{r}
Outputs <- tibble (files= list.files(here("data"), pattern= "Locus*")) |> 
  mutate(fasta= map(files, ~fasta_reader(here("data", .x))))
```

There are unverified sequences that screw this analysis

```{r}


Outputs |> 
  mutate(fasta= map(fasta, ~.x |> filter (!str_detect(header,seqs_to_remove )))) -> Outputs
```

```{r}
Outputs |> 
  mutate(nseq = map_dbl(fasta, nrow)) |> 
  filter (nseq>100) |> 
  mutate(len= map(fasta, ~.x |> 
                     mutate(len = str_length(seq)) |> 
                    select(header, len) |> 
  separate (header, into = c("seqID", "taxid", "taxonomy"), sep = "\\|"))) -> Outputs


Outputs |> 
  select(files,len) |> 
  unnest(len) |> 
  group_by(files, taxonomy) |> 
  tally()
```

Let's check Mustelidae

```{r}
Outputs |> 
  select(files,len) |> 
  unnest(len) |> 
  group_by(files, taxonomy) |> 
  tally() |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = files, values_from = n) |> 
  right_join(starting_point) |> 
  mutate(across(.fns =~.x/n, .cols= starts_with("Locus"))) |> 
  filter (str_starts(taxonomy,"Mustelidae")) |> 
  select(-n) |> 
  pivot_longer(-taxonomy,
               names_to = "Locus",
               
               values_to = "prop") |> 
  mutate(Locus =str_remove(Locus, "Locus_")) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x= Locus, y = prop))+
  geom_boxplot()
```
All primers work very well across mustelids - do they on american vison?

```{r}
Outputs |> 
  select(files,len) |> 
  unnest(len) |> 
  group_by(files, taxonomy) |> 
  tally() |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = files, values_from = n) |> 
   filter (str_detect(taxonomy,"vison")) |> 
  inner_join(starting_point) |> 
  mutate(across(.fns =~.x/n, .cols= starts_with("Locus"))) 
 
```

Yes - how different is the NeoGale vison sequence from the other mustelids

```{r}
Outputs |> 
  mutate(fasta = map(fasta, ~.x |>
                       filter (str_detect(header, "Mustelidae")) |> 
                       separate (header, into = c("seqID", "taxid", "taxonomy"), sep = "\\|") |> 
                       select(taxid, taxonomy, seq))) |> 
  select(files, fasta) -> mustelid_comparison

mustelid_comparison |> 
  mutate(Neogale_vison= map(fasta, ~.x |> 
                              filter(str_detect(taxonomy,"Neogale vison")) |> 
                              distinct(seq)  |> 
                              rename(target_seq = seq))) |> 
  mutate(fasta = map(fasta, ~.x |> 
                       distinct(taxid,taxonomy, seq))) -> mustelid_comparison
  mustelid_comparison |> 
    unnest(Neogale_vison) |> 
    unnest(fasta) |> 
  mutate(levenshtein_dist = stringdist(seq, target_seq, method = "lv"))-> distances_to_Vison
```
Visualization
```{r}

locus_labels <- distances_to_Vison |> 
  mutate(len = str_length(seq),
         locus = str_remove(files, "Locus_"),
          locus = str_remove(locus, ".fa"),
          locus = fct_reorder(locus, len, .fun= mean)) |> 
  
  group_by(locus) %>%
  summarise(mean_len = round(mean(len))) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(locus, " (", mean_len, " bp)")) %>%
  { setNames(.$label, .$locus) }


distances_to_Vison |> 
  mutate(len = str_length(seq)) |> 
  separate(taxonomy, into= c("family", "genus", "species"), sep = ";") |> 
  mutate (case = case_when(species == "Neogale vison" ~ "Intraespecific",
                           genus   == "Neogale"       ~ "Genus",
                           TRUE                       ~ "family"),
          locus = str_remove(files, "Locus_"),
          locus = str_remove(locus, ".fa"),
          locus = fct_reorder(locus, len, .fun= mean)) |> 
  ggplot (aes(x= case, y  = levenshtein_dist))+
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill= case))+
  facet_wrap(~locus, labeller = labeller(locus = locus_labels))
```
Hay algo raro con las secuencias de visones americanos -> fasta

```{r}
Outputs |> 
  select(files,fasta) |> 
  unnest() |> 
  filter(str_detect(header,"Neogale vison")) |> 
  separate(header, into= c("SeqID", "taxid", "taxonomy"), sep = "\\|") |> 
  group_by(files, taxonomy, taxid, seq) |> 
  summarise(SeqID=paste(SeqID, collapse = "|")) |> 
  unite(SeqID, taxid, taxonomy, col= "header", sep = ";") |> 
  group_by(files) |> 
  nest() |> 
  mutate(file= map2(files, data,
                    ~ fasta_writer(.y,
                                   header= header,
                                   sequence = seq,
                                   file.out = here("data", "N_vison", .x))))
  
```
